sources.title: Washington L&I - City Electrical Permits & Inspections
sources.supports: Listed cities issue electrical permits and perform inspections in city limits; L&I does not. Federal Way Permit Center, 33325 8th Ave South, 253-835-2607. Links DOR address lookup; verify jurisdiction before buying a permit.

sources.title: City of Federal Way - Permit Center
sources.supports: Population approx. 102,000; wire-transfer fraud alert; staff hours 9-4 Mon/Tue/Thu/Fri, closed Wednesdays; permitcenter@federalwaywa.gov, 253-835-2607; residential electrical/mechanical/plumbing permits via MyBuildingPermit; E-Permits archive for past permits only.

sources.title: MyBuildingPermit
sources.supports: Online application portal the City names for residential electrical permits.

sources.title: City of Federal Way - E-Permits Archive
sources.supports: Archive for past residential electrical, mechanical and plumbing permits.

sources.title: City of Federal Way - Electrical Permit Application
sources.supports: Asks for electrical contractor's WA contractor license number, expiration date, UBI number, project valuation, and work description.

sources.title: City of Federal Way - Construction Codes
sources.supports: NEC 2023 edition with Washington amendments WAC 296-46B and RCW 19.28; Federal Way Revised Code holds local amendments.

sources.title: Federal Way Revised Code
sources.supports: Local amendments to state-adopted codes and administrative procedures.

sources.title: City of Federal Way - Residential Permit Exemptions
sources.supports: Electrical exemptions limited to cord-and-plug decorative lighting, reinstalling plug receptacles, replacing branch-circuit overcurrent devices of required capacity in same location, low-voltage work, minor repairs; if in doubt call 253.835.2607.

sources.title: Washington L&I - Electrical Permit Basics
sources.supports: Whoever performs the work buys the permit; a hired person asking owner to buy permit is against the law and permit not valid; like-in-kind circuit breaker exemption is branch-circuit only.

sources.title: WAC 296-46B-901
sources.supports: Statewide list of electrical work that does or does not require a permit and inspection.

sources.title: Puget Sound Energy - Permits and inspections
sources.supports: Federal Way listed among city jurisdictions that perform their own electrical inspections.

sources.title: Puget Sound Energy - Construction Tips and FAQs
sources.supports: For weatherhead/meter base/panel repair or replacement PSE disconnects service so the electrical contractor can work safely; cost depends on labor and crew; call 1-888-321-7779 at least 5 business days ahead. (No dollar amounts used.)

sources.title: Washington L&I - Purchase Permits & Request Inspections
sources.supports: Contact serving utility when power must be disconnected and reconnected; comply with its requirements; hired contractor must buy the permit.

sources.title: Puget Sound Energy - Meter Tampering and Diversion
sources.supports: Tampering includes unauthorized meter removal, cutting seals, opening meter base, self-reconnects; adding an EV charging station listed among projects that may require PSE notice.

sources.title: City of Federal Way - Inspection Information
sources.supports: Phone IVR being phased out; schedule at inspection.mybuildingpermit.com; may take up to 48 hours; reasons inspections will not be performed.

sources.title: MyBuildingPermit Inspections
sources.supports: Online inspection scheduling used by Federal Way.

sources.title: City of Federal Way - Bulletin #163 Scheduling Inspections Electrical/Mechanical/Plumbing (March 18, 2026)
sources.supports: Request before 4:00 pm; inspections typically 8:30-4:00 M-F; up to 72 hours; electrical inspection types incl. Service, Feeders/Sub-Panels, Rough Electrical, UFER Ground, Final Electrical.

sources.title: Puget Sound Energy - Electric Service Handbook 2026, Single-Family Residential
sources.supports: Installation must pass electrical inspection by state or city jurisdiction before PSE energizes; permit must be present for customer-side work; modified services may be energized if permit present and work safe/complete with inspection next day.

sources.title: City of Federal Way - Property Owner Electrical Work Permit Affidavit (Bulletin #170)
sources.supports: Only licensed electrical contractors may perform electrical work in WA; owner exemption via affidavit under RCW 19.28.261; name must be on deed; agents/property managers/relatives cannot buy permit for owner; renters need rental agreement.

sources.title: RCW 19.28.261 Exemptions
sources.supports: Owner may do electrical work on own residence/property without license unless new building for rent/sale/lease or property offered for sale within 12 months after obtaining it.

sources.title: Washington L&I - Hiring an Electrical Contractor
sources.supports: Verify license, bond and electrician certification; contractor gets permits/inspections; city-permitted jobsites search records with the city; unpermitted work may cause problems at sale.

sources.title: Washington DOR - Tax Rate Lookup
sources.supports: Address lookup L&I uses to confirm whether an address is within city limits.

sources.title: Washington L&I - Verify a Contractor, Tradesperson or Business
sources.supports: Contractor license, bond, insurance and electrician certification lookup.
